headings: Retro Computer Festival 2026 (Space Edition) - Saturday 14th November
Retro Computer Festival 2026 is Go for landing! This year we'll boldly go to a galaxy far far away. And Houston, we hope there's no problems. As you might have guessed, the theme is SPACE!

We'll be dedicating another entire weekend to the Retro Computing Community - and this time it's the space edition ! Expect to see micros and consoles from the 70s, 80s and 90s running space games, plotting the heavens and emulating space craft - and much more!
More to come! Please keep checking back!
